description: This file implements file system consistency checking (fsck) mechanisms within a version control system (likely Git). It includes functions for validating, parsing, and reporting issues with objects such as commits, trees, tags, and blobs, and manages message types and external references relevant for fsck operations.

methods.name: void prepare_msg_ids(void)
methods.description: Initializes and prepares message identifiers by converting their string IDs into lowercase and camel case versions for internal use.

methods.name: int parse_msg_id(const char * text)
methods.description: Parses a string message ID and returns its index or -1 if not found.

methods.name: void list_config_fsck_msg_ids(struct string_list * list,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Lists all registered fsck message IDs with a specified prefix.

methods.name: enum:fsck_msg_type fsck_msg_type(enum fsck_msg_id msg_id,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Determines the message type for a given message ID considering strictness and options.

methods.name: enum:fsck_msg_type parse_msg_type(const char * str)
methods.description: Converts a string representation of message type ('error', 'warn', 'ignore') into its enum value.

methods.name: int is_valid_msg_type(const char * msg_id,const char * msg_type)
methods.description: Checks if provided message ID and message type strings are valid.

methods.name: void fsck_set_msg_type_from_ids(struct fsck_options * options,enum fsck_msg_id msg_id,enum fsck_msg_type msg_type)
methods.description: Sets the message severity for a specific message ID within fsck options.

methods.name: void fsck_set_msg_type(struct fsck_options * options,const char * msg_id_str,const char * msg_type_str)
methods.description: Sets the message severity for a given message ID string based on message type string.

methods.name: void fsck_set_msg_types(struct fsck_options * options,const char * values)
methods.description: Parses a colon/comma-separated list to configure multiple message types.

methods.name: int object_on_skiplist(struct fsck_options * opts,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if an object ID is in the skiplist based on options.

methods.name: int fsck_vreport(struct fsck_options * options,void * fsck_report,enum fsck_msg_id msg_id,const char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Core reporting function that formats messages and calls the registered error function.

methods.name: int report(struct fsck_options * options,const struct object_id * oid,enum object_type object_type,enum fsck_msg_id msg_id,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Public interface for reporting messages related to objects, taking printf-like formatting.

methods.name: int fsck_report_ref(struct fsck_options * options,struct fsck_ref_report * report,enum fsck_msg_id msg_id,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Reports reference-related messages.

methods.name: void fsck_enable_object_names(struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Enables mapping object IDs to names in options.

methods.name: const char * fsck_get_object_name(struct fsck_options * options,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Retrieves the name for an object ID if available.

methods.name: void fsck_put_object_name(struct fsck_options * options,const struct object_id * oid,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Associates a name with an object ID.

methods.name: const char * fsck_describe_object(struct fsck_options * options,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Returns a textual description of an object, including its name if available.

methods.name: int fsck_walk_tree(struct tree * tree,void * data,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Recursively walks a tree object, verifying its entries and calling the walk callback.

methods.name: int fsck_walk_commit(struct commit * commit,void * data,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Walks a commit object, verifying its tree and parent commits.

methods.name: int fsck_walk_tag(struct tag * tag,void * data,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Walks a tag object, verifying its tagged object.

methods.name: int fsck_walk(struct object * obj,void * data,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Dispatches walk operation based on object type.

methods.name: void name_stack_push(struct name_stack * stack,const char * name)
methods.description: Pushes a name onto the name stack.

methods.name: const char * name_stack_pop(struct name_stack * stack)
methods.description: Pops a name from the name stack.

methods.name: void name_stack_clear(struct name_stack * stack)
methods.description: Clears the name stack.

methods.name: int verify_ordered(unsigned mode1,const char * name1,unsigned mode2,const char * name2,struct name_stack * candidates)
methods.description: Verifies the order of tree entries to enforce sorting rules.

methods.name: int fsck_tree(const struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * buffer,unsigned long size,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Validates a tree object, checking for nulls, duplicates, mode issues, and sorting.

methods.name: int verify_headers(const void * data,unsigned long size,const struct object_id * oid,enum object_type type,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Checks commit or tag object headers for proper formatting and termination.

methods.name: timestamp_t parse_timestamp_from_buf(const char ** start,const char * end)
methods.description: Parses a timestamp from a buffer segment.

methods.name: int fsck_ident(const char ** ident,const char * ident_end,const struct object_id * oid,enum object_type type,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Validates the author/committer line in commit objects.

methods.name: int fsck_commit(const struct object_id * oid,const char * buffer,unsigned long size,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Validates commit object syntax, headers, and fields.

methods.name: int fsck_tag(const struct object_id * oid,const char * buffer,unsigned long size,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Validates a tag object.

methods.name: int fsck_tag_standalone(const struct object_id * oid,const char * buffer,unsigned long size,struct fsck_options * options,struct object_id * tagged_oid,int * tagged_type)
methods.description: Validates the content of a tag object, including headers and fields.

methods.name: int fsck_gitmodules_fn(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * vdata)
methods.description: Checks contents of .gitmodules submodule configuration for disallowed values.

methods.name: int fsck_blob(const struct object_id * oid,const char * buf,unsigned long size,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Validates blob objects, especially .gitmodules and .gitattributes files for syntax issues and size limits.

methods.name: int fsck_object(struct object * obj,void * data,unsigned long size,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Main dispatch function to fsck an arbitrary object.

methods.name: int fsck_buffer(const struct object_id * oid,enum object_type type,const void * data,unsigned long size,struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: Dispatches buffer to specific object type validation functions.

methods.name: int fsck_objects_error_cb_print_missing_gitmodules(struct fsck_options * o,void * fsck_report,enum fsck_msg_type msg_type,enum fsck_msg_id msg_id,const char * message)
methods.description: Error callback that prints IDs of missing gitmodules objects.

methods.name: int fsck_blobs(struct oidset * blobs_found,struct oidset * blobs_done,enum fsck_msg_id msg_missing,enum fsck_msg_id msg_type,struct fsck_options * options,const char * blob_type)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int fsck_finish(struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: bool fsck_has_queued_checks(struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int fsck_objects_error_function(struct fsck_options * o,void * fsck_report,enum fsck_msg_type msg_type,enum fsck_msg_id msg_id UNUSED,const char * message)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void fsck_options_clear(struct fsck_options * options)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int fsck_refs_error_function(struct fsck_options * options UNUSED,void * fsck_report,enum fsck_msg_type msg_type,enum fsck_msg_id msg_id UNUSED,const char * message)

methods.name: int git_fsck_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)

methods.description: unavailable
